thesis: Mohnish Pabrai argues that finding a good investment manager is harder than finding a good investment and suggests looking for aligned fee structures, significant skin in the game, a mid-40s age range, a track record of outperforming the market with lower risk, and a strategy that avoids crowded markets. He also states that he finds these sessions valuable because he often feels wiser after receiving comments, questions, or pushbacks from the audience.
